# PostgreSQL 17 新增的增量备份怎么使用，需要什么前提？引用官方文档。

以下报告仅综合已通过核验的研究结论，并为每项事实保留可回溯的证据引用。

## PostgreSQL 17 增量备份 · 功能概述与组件

pg_combinebackup 用于从增量备份及其依赖的早期备份重建合成全量备份 [evidence:78b82be6a218408d950fd29245e61f9bad79a62b3d068578] [evidence:77b54a83cbb65a2fc13c4d5b69af0dbc16c6478de0330d79] [evidence:a97b6a338434a69a8a2a0853e5f6c6ca36e66e62629873ae] [evidence:496c1fa7888850b0413e3551811009109fc84f0eb2592b3a]

## PostgreSQL 17 增量备份 · 合并为完整备份的步骤

pg_combinebackup 用于从增量备份及其依赖的早期备份重建合成完整备份 [evidence:b9ea7dfdf0d3788db410ce34ef07298c2dbb9c37a12d610f] [evidence:3b10a95784767b7688dff98bbd8343e27abed018a512fce6] [evidence:41a53a7aed4e31ff0efadd43ae014301adc2ded2b4da5dd2]

## PostgreSQL 17 增量备份 · 恢复与失败场景注意事项

若删除了增量备份所依赖的一个或多个先前备份，将无法恢复该增量备份。 [evidence:e5568e69dd648959dddd20430a8fc87a5a968a7f928cb5e1] [evidence:53e50cedf81da7063d6c8231c8d936856429cfe259dae723] [evidence:f891d914e306325010a93535b379256d324ee08e146bd384]

## PostgreSQL 17 增量备份 · 使用前提与配置要求

pg_basebackup 默认生成 manifest 文件（除非使用 --no-manifest），该文件是增量备份所需的参考 [evidence:2e4be75d5ca9744b2674c0287baf59f01252bfd14f9f88d8] [evidence:ba93b95306098df2ef4378d1e979792508dc691d045c5e91] [evidence:b8e51a4e5ef4cb7c93669be962bed062f9c4ea2d77dd6099]

## PostgreSQL 17 增量备份 · 创建增量备份的步骤与命令

使用 pg_basebackup 的新选项 -i, --incremental=OLDMANIFEST 即可创建增量备份 [evidence:05fb491a3b2115cc20cf195c8842326bed7c6dae2f8f6bd7] [evidence:df51e9457e1daa0bacba79560ca1df5a62dbaec786609993] [evidence:14dd66939b612506f4e96ce3e8f4be8758bb153bfdb78581]

## PostgreSQL 17 增量备份 · 限制与版本差异

--incremental 选项不存在于 PostgreSQL 17 之前的版本 [evidence:6508cd4142ba0591c65d6f4f8d8fca88b98ea7586cc6f1ed] [evidence:44efe8deac8f42916d169354b079d878df52ddeb24e696c1]

## Citation audit

### PostgreSQL 17 增量备份 · 功能概述与组件

- Evidence: `evidence:78b82be6a218408d950fd29245e61f9bad79a62b3d068578`
- Exact quote: “pg\\_combinebackup is used to reconstruct a synthetic full backup from an [incremental backup](continuous-archiving.html#BACKUP-INCREMENTAL-BACKUP "25.3.3. Making an Incremental Backup") and the earlier backups upon which it depends.”
- Snapshot: `research/external/50ed0df5-3027-4324-9ac4-96899293151b/71eb219605d290817769abf35d939a81ac22b4f1327ffaaab5673fed1f2c119a`
- URL: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/app-pgcombinebackup.html

### PostgreSQL 17 增量备份 · 合并为完整备份的步骤

- Evidence: `evidence:b9ea7dfdf0d3788db410ce34ef07298c2dbb9c37a12d610f`
- Exact quote: “pg\\_combinebackup is used to reconstruct a synthetic full backup from an [incremental backup](continuous-archiving.html#BACKUP-INCREMENTAL-BACKUP "25.3.3. Making an Incremental Backup") and the earlier backups upon which it depends.”
- Snapshot: `research/external/50ed0df5-3027-4324-9ac4-96899293151b/71eb219605d290817769abf35d939a81ac22b4f1327ffaaab5673fed1f2c119a`
- URL: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/app-pgcombinebackup.html

### PostgreSQL 17 增量备份 · 恢复与失败场景注意事项

- Evidence: `evidence:e5568e69dd648959dddd20430a8fc87a5a968a7f928cb5e1`
- Exact quote: “If you remove one or more of the previous backups upon which your incremental backup relies, you will not be able to restore it.”
- Snapshot: `research/external/50ed0df5-3027-4324-9ac4-96899293151b/71eb219605d290817769abf35d939a81ac22b4f1327ffaaab5673fed1f2c119a`
- URL: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/app-pgcombinebackup.html

### PostgreSQL 17 增量备份 · 使用前提与配置要求

- Evidence: `evidence:2e4be75d5ca9744b2674c0287baf59f01252bfd14f9f88d8`
- Exact quote: “This basebackup by default creates a manifest file unless `--no-manifest`is supplied.”
- Snapshot: `research/external/bda7fb10-b45d-424e-bdc7-0b24175d718a/666b64451c91b0dfaeff9203b865b37ec1a291c5aa4bbefbe389766c77156da9`
- URL: https://hexacluster.ai/blog/full-and-incremental-backup-using-pg-basebackup-and-pg-combinebackup-in-postgresql

### PostgreSQL 17 增量备份 · 创建增量备份的步骤与命令

- Evidence: `evidence:05fb491a3b2115cc20cf195c8842326bed7c6dae2f8f6bd7`
- Exact quote: “use `pg_basebackup` with the new `-i, --incremental=OLDMANIFEST` option”
- Snapshot: `research/external/bda7fb10-b45d-424e-bdc7-0b24175d718a/821648a36ead11df91ccc544517c500c57c8ced950547679d32f3ed6961cf143`
- URL: https://pgdash.io/blog/incremental-backup-in-postgresql-17.html

### PostgreSQL 17 增量备份 · 创建增量备份的步骤与命令

- Evidence: `evidence:df51e9457e1daa0bacba79560ca1df5a62dbaec786609993`
- Exact quote: “$ pg_basebackup -D backup2_incr -i backup1/backup_manifest -c fast -p 7000 -v”
- Snapshot: `research/external/bda7fb10-b45d-424e-bdc7-0b24175d718a/821648a36ead11df91ccc544517c500c57c8ced950547679d32f3ed6961cf143`
- URL: https://pgdash.io/blog/incremental-backup-in-postgresql-17.html

### PostgreSQL 17 增量备份 · 限制与版本差异

- Evidence: `evidence:6508cd4142ba0591c65d6f4f8d8fca88b98ea7586cc6f1ed`
- Exact quote: “option to take incremental backups which is not present in versions before PostgreSQL 17”
- Snapshot: `research/external/bda7fb10-b45d-424e-bdc7-0b24175d718a/666b64451c91b0dfaeff9203b865b37ec1a291c5aa4bbefbe389766c77156da9`
- URL: https://hexacluster.ai/blog/full-and-incremental-backup-using-pg-basebackup-and-pg-combinebackup-in-postgresql

  - Snapshot: `research/external/50ed0df5-3027-4324-9ac4-96899293151b/71eb219605d290817769abf35d939a81ac22b4f1327ffaaab5673fed1f2c119a`

  - URL: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/app-pgcombinebackup.html
